name: grimoire
description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Three skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders one self-contained page that reads any configuration back; groundtrack, which turns a plan or a written change into a call graph with recorded traces through it, on a page a reader can step; and contract, which interviews a person to agree the terms for a skill or an agent of their own, then generates its file from that contract and checks its format.
